label: manuell klären
gates: edition only level 2 - correct edition not secured

edition.check: Level 5: requires a barcode in the input. NOT MET, because the input has only title, artist and format. Level 4 requires that no other edition fitting the input has a different tracklist. NOT MET: the MB search (step 2) shows the 2014 box set (fc1eb6d6, 6+7+2+15+4 tracks) and the 2023 10th Anniversary 3×Vinyl (4375c18f, 6+7+9 = 22 tracks). Both are Vinyl, same artist and title, with different tracklists, and the input does not rule them out. Level 3 requires that all fitting editions share the same tracklist. NOT MET, for the same reason. Level 2 applies when several editions fit, at least one has a different tracklist, and the choice rests on weak signals. MET: the standard 2×LP (MB 4867ceba / Discogs 4570366, plus repressings with identical tracklists) is the plausible default, but this rests only on the assumption that an unqualified input means the standard album.
edition.summary: Without a barcode, the input 'Vinyl' also fits the 2014 box set and the 22-track 10th Anniversary 3×LP, which have different tracklists, so the choice of the standard 2×LP rests on a plausibility assumption.

tracklist.check: Level 5 requires at least two independent sources of the same edition agreeing on count, order and titles. MET: MB 4867ceba (step 5) and Discogs 4570366 (step 6) both describe the standard 2×LP (barcode 888837168618, catno 88883716861). Both list 13 tracks A1–D4 in identical order with identical titles, differing only in capitalisation and apostrophe style. Durations deviate by at most 2 s (A1, A2, C2, D4), which is rounding.
tracklist.summary: MusicBrainz and Discogs entries for the same standard 2×LP agree fully on 13 tracks, their order and titles.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5 requires a database plus an independent primary source (cover, label print). NOT MET: no cover or booklet was read. Level 4 requires two independent database entries recognisable by differing details. MET: MB (DE, ISRCs, ms durations) and Discogs (UK/Europe/US, runout matrices, slightly different durations) differ in details, so they are independent.
sources.summary: Two independent database entries (MusicBrainz and Discogs) with differing details, but no primary source.

concerns: The skill instructs status 'ambiguous' when fitting candidates have different tracklists. Despite the 10th Anniversary 3×LP (22 tracks) and the 2014 box set fitting the Vinyl input, the agent set status 'found'.
Country 'DE' comes from the MB release detail. The MB search listed the same MBID as 2013-05-20 FR, and Discogs 4570366 is 'UK, Europe & US', so the country attribution is inconsistent.
The 'Drumless Edition' alternative (discogs:release/28924120) does not appear in the visible evidence; the search output was truncated, so it is unverified.
The alternative note claims 2017/2021/2022 reissues have an 'identical tracklist', but their tracklists were not fetched (only search hits).
